The alter_existing_thesis call returned two NVDA suggestions, so no new thesis is needed for NVDA. The next call should be revise_projections, which covers the NVDA claims that state forward figures with metric, period, value and unit: c2 (consensus China revenue of $2.5bn for FQ4), c9 (FQ4 revenue estimate of $89bn), c10 (roughly $0.05 quarterly EPS impact) and c11 (FQ4 China assumption cut to $0). Claim c6 gives a share of an allocation, not a projection, so I leave it out.

The claims concern NVDA, which is in the book, so alter_existing_thesis must be called first with all claim IDs. The claims bear on NVDA.p1 (China/Data Center demand) and NVDA.p3 (pricing and margin), and on the packaging supply pillar less directly. After that, revise_projections is supported because c9 and c11 state forward FQ4 figures with metric, period, value and unit, such as China revenue at $0 and FQ4 revenue of $89bn. Three tool calls at most.
